reason_for_revision: Add two ACL 2026 methods discovered through official publication-to-repository verification before any accepted WMA result exists, while fail-closing methods without executable or licensed official code.
inherited_without_change: all prior method assignments except explicitly updated source gates

effective_coverage.note: Counts distinguish bibliographic registry rows from independently executable method entities. HeLa-Mem remains registered but execution-blocked until licensed.

effective_group_adjustments.change: StructMem may enter source materialization; HeLa-Mem is visible in the fixed comparison surface but cannot execute without a verified license.
Memory-R1 has an official repository without released method code; APEX-MEM and ACL LightMem have no verified official code; the zjunlp repository is explicitly rejected as ACL LightMem code.

execution_gates.structmem: Freeze an exact source-only materialization and license audit, then freeze a method-specific WMA lifecycle adapter before numeric execution.
execution_gates.hela-mem: No source copy, adaptation, environment creation, or execution until an explicit upstream license or other permission is recorded.
execution_gates.memory-r1: No execution until a later official revision contains executable method code.
execution_gates.apex-mem: No execution until an author-controlled official source is verified.
execution_gates.lightmem: No execution until an author-controlled source for ACL 2026 long.588 is verified without name collision.

selection_and_numeric_policy: The revision is based only on recency, identity, official-code availability, licensing, and task compatibility. No source-reported score or future AgentEnhance score may remove a registered method, select a favorable subset, or fill a local-result cell.
prohibited_actions: Do not use zjunlp/LightMem as the implementation of ACL 2026 LightMem.
Do not execute or redistribute HeLa-Mem repository content without a verified license or permission.
Do not treat a repository README or paper number as a local reproduction.
Do not edit v1 or v2 artifacts to hide the prospective registry revision.
Do not import source-reported scores into same-protocol local-result rows.
